One sees light of various colors like an emanation of all the world realms, and like an illusion, a rainbow, a mirage, the moon reflected in water, and a reflected image. From that blue lotus <note>original: utpala</note> arises the blue Tara, having two hands. The right hand holds a trident <note>original: trishula</note>, and the left hand holds a blue lotus together with its stem. Her beautiful body is adorned with jeweled necklaces, earrings, armlets, and various kinds of ornaments. She is in the prime of youth, with a smiling face, and sits in the balanced cross-legged posture <note>original: mnyam pa'i skyil mo krung</note> upon a moon and a lotus. To the south, upon a moon and a lotus, from the syllable <term>Re</term> arises a yellow lotus together with its seed, from which light pervades all the world realms. With light of various colors, the world <unclear>rest of line missing or obscured</unclear>

<summary>This page describes the visualization of a blue Tara arising from a lotus, detailing her ornaments, posture, and symbolic attributes. It begins the transition to a second visualization of a yellow lotus in the southern direction.</summary>
